Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.

Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time.

summary:
Data Communication

Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.

Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal.

title: I2C

summary:
Data Communication

Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.

Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal.

title: I2C

contents:
Data Communication Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.
Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal.
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time

title: I2C

contents:
Data Communication Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.
Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal. Eg: I2C, SPI
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time
Full Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction at the same time

Data Communication Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.
Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal. Eg: I2C, SPI
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time
Full Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction at the same time

title: I2C

contents:
Data Communication Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.
Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal. Eg: I2C, SPI
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time
Full Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction at the same time

contents:

Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal. Eg: I2C, SPI
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time
Full Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction at the same time

title: I2C

contents:
Data Communication Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.
Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal. Eg: I2C, SPI
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time
Full Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction at the same time

Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal. Eg: I2C, SPI
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time
Full Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction at the same time

Baud Rate is the data transfer rate on bits per sec.
UART Protocol requires a start bit and a stop bit. Data length can vary froom 5 bits to 9 bits. Non Return to zero) encoding is used for transmission

Duplex Data can be transmitted and received

UART Protocol requires a start bit and a stop bit. Data length can vary froom 5 bits to 9 bits. These should be configured before using UART. NRZ (Non Return to zero) encoding is used for transmission. UART uses little endian bit ordering,ehich means the least significant bit is transmitted first.

contents:
Data Communication Data transfers can happen either serially or parallely. In serial communication,data bits are transmitted one by one whereas in parallel commuication, all bits are transmitted simultaneously.
Serial Communication can be asynchronous or synchronous. In asynchronous serial communication, a single byte is transferred at a time. It does not require a clock signal. Eg: UART In Synchronous coommunication,a block of data is transferred at a time. It requires a clock signal. Eg: I2C, SPI
Some Terms Simplex Data is transmitted only in one direction.
Duplex Data can be transmitted and received
Half Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction but only one eay at a time
Full Duplex Data is transmitted in both direction at the same time

contents:
UART is a two wired Asynchronous serial communication protocol
For UART Communication, we need to configure both devices with same speeed, i.e. baud rate.
Baud Rate is the data transfer rate on bits per sec.
UART Protocol requires a start bit and a stop bit. Data length can vary froom 5 bits to 9 bits. These should be configured before using UART. It uses NRZ (Non Return to zero) encoding for transmission. UART uses little endian bit ordering,w hich means the least significant bit is transmitted first.
